zh.name: 有光
zh.description: 人活着，究竟为了什么？有光：一个慢慢读、慢慢找答案的地方。
zh.hiSub: 答案也许就在某一格里。点一格看看。
zh.footerLine: 愿你在这里遇见生命的光。

en.name: Light
en.description: What are we really living for? Light is a quiet place to read, listen and look for the answer.
en.hi: What are we really living for?
en.hiSub: The answer may be in one of these tiles. Tap one.
en.footerLine: May you meet the light of life here.
